implementation_summary: runAuditCrawl(request, opts) fetches robots.txt through makeCheckerFetch (allowPrivate false). It builds one HostPacer per audit (minGapMs 500 or the robots Crawl-delay if larger) and opens a browser context via deps.browserManager or its own BrowserManager (closed at the end). It installs the request guard (deps.requestGuard ?? makeRequestGuard(netDeps)), then blockChanges. It runs the DeterministicSpider with maxPages and maxDepth from the limits, exploreClicks false, followFormActions false, seedSitemap true, robots, pacer, and outboundFetch from makeCheckerFetch with the pacer. admitPath applies pathLimitVerdict ('excluded') then isCheckoutPath ('payment'); inspectPage is pageAreaVerdict. onPage and onSkipped drive redacted onProgress counts, each path counted once using skipKey. onRecordedPage captures finalUrl from the depth-0 page and passes the page to onRenderedPage. The result has pages (urlPath, title, depth, layoutGroup, links, screenshotPath), coverage with Skipped Pages de-duplicated by skipKey and never also recorded, leavingSite grouped from the links that leave the site, signInWalls, and paymentAreas; a final progress event carries the final counts. The deps seam (browserManager, requestGuard, netDeps) is in-process only. The barrel exports crawl, reachability, limits and area-detect.
